Kaia Morgan: Hi team! Im Kaia (they/them), started today on platform reliability. I collect novelty socks, make pancakes on weekends, and have a hedgehog named Mochi. Looking forward to meeting folks in person 
Ben Cho: welcome kaia!! :tada: Mochi pics required. Also we have a pancake & pastry run on Fridays if youre into that :pancakes:
Lina Patel: hi kaia — welcome! what office are you in? Ill drop by later with a sticker pack. also coffee/tea poll: coffee/black tea/matcha/iced
Kaia Morgan: thanks all! Im on the 6th floor hot desk for now. Pancakes are a must. Mochis pic incoming in a sec 
Marco Ruiz: @reception-bot any badge updates? Kaia needs access to 6F and the maker room
reception-bot: Badge request for Kaia Morgan received. Ready for pickup at reception by 10:30am. Access granted: 6F, maker-room (temporary) 
Juno Park: hey Kaia, welcome. we do a casual 30min maker hang w/ soldering & snacks on Wednesdays. bring Mochis tiny sweater if you want to show off :laughing:
Kaia Morgan: uploading Mochi pic link: https://imgur.com/a/123fake (hes dramatic about naps). And Im team pancake forever :heart:
Ben Cho: added you to the pancake list. dietary Qs: vegan ok? GF? 
Kaia Morgan: no allergies, vegan pancakes are great. Could someone point me to the bike rack? Ill be commuting tomorrow 
Lina Patel: bike rack is around the alley door on the west side. I left a note on onboarding doc with directions 
Marco Ruiz: welcome again Kaia. Theres a quick intro huddle at 3pm in conf A if you want to swing by. Also funny prop: we collect novelty socks for the annual sock swap :socks:
Kaia Morgan: thanks! Ill try to make the 3pm huddle. Appreciate the warm welcome :blush:
